description: Compares the position's current pool against the rest of the manager's set and, when the gap is worth it, returns the numbers for a move: destination pool, ticks, and how much liquidity. A pool sharing no currency with the position is suggested only when the manager (v2.2) can bridge to it through another of its own pools; the answer then names that bridge. It returns NUMBERS, never calldata — pass them to the local envelop-mcp-lp server's propose_move, which re-derives each one against chain state and puts it through the policy and the price-oracle guard before anything is signed. The full ranking and the caveats come back with every answer so the suggestion can be disagreed with.

chainId.description: EVM chain id, e.g. 42161 for Arbitrum One

minGainPct.description: Minimum APR advantage, in percentage points, before moving is suggested. Default 1.

name: suggest_move
title: Suggest moving a position to a better-paying pool
